title: Christmas toy deals 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for
seoTitle: Christmas Toy Deals 2026: Buy Now or Wait for Black Friday?
description: Which of 2026's top Christmas toys are already reduced at Argos, Smyths and Very, what to wait for, and the prices worth paying.
intro:
**Several of this year's most-wanted toys are already well below their launch prices, including the Primal Hatch Megalodon at £33 and the PAW Patrol Megasaurus at £40.** Argos and Smyths have started their Black Friday toy offers early, with half price on many Barbie, Hot Wheels and Bluey toys.

Our advice: buy the hot toys now, before they sell out, and wait for Black Friday week on LEGO and Switch 2 games. Prices checked on 9 November 2026.

body:
## Why now?

Toys are one of the few categories where waiting for Black Friday on 27 November can cost you. The most-wanted toys are made in fixed numbers for Christmas, and in most years the top sellers go out of stock in late November and early December rather than getting cheaper. This year Argos and Smyths have both started their Black Friday toy offers early, so many of the hot toys are already below their launch prices.

Argos's toy offers page (checked 9 November) has up to 50% off selected toys, extra savings on some items with the codes TOYS25 and TOYS50, multi-buys such as 3 for £20 and 2 for £30, and up to a third off selected LEGO. Many toys carry Argos's **Price Guarantee** badge: if the price of a badged item falls before Christmas Day, Argos sends you an e-gift card for the difference. Smyths has its Black Friday toy deals live, plus £5 off every £50 on selected LEGO. There's no '3 for 2 on everything' this year, so compare prices item by item.

## This year's most-wanted toys

Argos's Top 20 Christmas toys list includes the **Primal Hatch Megalodon** hatching shark egg, the **PAW Patrol Dino Movie Megasaurus**, the adults' **LEGO Super Mario Donkey Kong Arcade (72051)**, LEGO Pokémon SMART Play sets, the Toniebox Lite and KPop Demon Hunters dolls. Hamleys' festive top toys list also features the Megalodon, plus Barbie dolls from *The Nutcracker* and the pocket-money Big Squij.

The Megalodon and the Megasaurus are both already cut. The Megalodon is £33 at Argos, down from its £55 launch price, and £32.99 at Smyths. The Megasaurus is £40 at Argos and £39.99 at Smyths, down from £60. Those are prices worth taking now. Hot toys rarely go much lower than this, and both look likely to sell out.

## What to buy now and what to wait for

**Buy now:**

- **Top 20 and 'must-have' toys.** If a child has asked for something specific, buy it when it's a fair price. Last-minute shortages are the bigger risk.
- **Half-price character toys** from Barbie, Hot Wheels, Bluey and PAW Patrol. Argos already has many at 50% off, which is about as low as these ranges go at Black Friday.
- **Price Guarantee items at Argos.** If one gets cheaper before Christmas, you get the difference back as a gift card.

**Worth waiting for:**

- **LEGO.** LEGO's own Black Friday starts on 27 November, with an Insiders weekend expected from 21 November, and retailers usually match or beat it. Bigger adult sets such as Concorde (£130 at Argos today, normally £170) are fair buys now, but we'd only pay full price for brand-new sets. Our [LEGO Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the target prices.
- **Nintendo Switch 2 games.** Mario Kart World is still £74.99 at Argos with no discount. Wait for Black Friday week; our [Switch 2 Black Friday guide](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) tracks bundles.
- **Amazon.** Amazon hadn't started its Black Friday sale by 9 November. It's expected to begin around 19 November, so check it before buying anything that isn't a hot toy.

## Target prices

These are the prices we'd be happy to pay this month, based on what we've seen at Argos, Smyths and Very today:

- **Primal Hatch Megalodon:** £33 or less (launched at £55)
- **PAW Patrol Megasaurus:** £40 or less (launched at £60)
- **LEGO Donkey Kong Arcade 72051:** under £130. It's £127.99 at Smyths, £150 at Argos
- **Mid-size Barbie and Hot Wheels playsets:** half the list price, so around £25 for a £50 set
- **Sylvanian Families big playsets:** around 40% off, such as the Baby Castle Nursery at £47.99

## How to choose a toy that gets played with

- **Check the age on the box.** Many of this year's hits, such as the Megalodon, aren't suitable for under-3s, and some LEGO sets are designed for adults.
- **Count the batteries.** Electronic toys often need AA or AAA batteries that aren't included. Add a pack to your basket.
- **Think about space.** Big playsets like dreamhouses and car washes take up a lot of floor. Ask the parents first.
- **Set a budget per child.** Multi-buys like Argos's 3 for £20 make it easy to overspend on small toys. Our [Christmas gifts for kids under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-kids-under-20/) and [STEM gifts for kids](/guides/stem-gifts-for-kids/) guides have more ideas.

## Where to buy

Argos has the widest range of offers right now and the most generous Christmas returns: anything bought from 23 September to 25 December can go back until 31 January 2027 if it's unused. Smyths often matches Argos to the penny and sometimes beats it. Very and John Lewis are worth checking for Sylvanian Families, Squishmallows and LEGO. Hamleys earns us a small commission, but its site wasn't available when we checked today. We'll add its prices when we can confirm them.

For everything else on sale this month, see our [Black Friday 2026 guides](/black-friday/) and [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

Shopping at Hamleys? See what's already half price in our [Hamleys Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/).
